name: Shonen action
means: A heavy black keyline around every figure, bold angular eyes with thick lids, hard high-contrast shadow, aggressive foreshortening toward the viewer, and drawn ink effects - speed lines, motion lines - doing the work a camera would do in live action.
tags: shounen style, thick lineart, bold heavy outlines, bold angular eyes, high contrast, dynamic angle, foreshortening, radial speed lines
prose: a boys' action-manga animation frame: heavy black outlines, hard high-contrast shadow, extreme foreshortening, drawn speed lines filling the background
negative_add: thin lineart, soft lighting, pastel colors, photorealistic, motion blur
works_for: video - good on the drawing, bad on the effects. Thick outlines and flat fills hold; radial speed lines are a dense field of thin converging strokes and will churn. INFERRED. The project already has a better answer anyway: author the hit as shot.fx flash or whiteout in short.py fx_chain, which is post and exact every frame.
note: This is a BUNDLE rather than a single feature, which is why it is moderate and not strong - each part lands but nothing fires on the word shounen alone. Two of the parts are measured. cards/anime_draw_line_weight.json found that thick versus normal is a real switch, its clause being 'thick lineart, bold heavy outlines', while the thin end has no gradation at all (extremely thin and thin render identically). cards/anime_draw_eye_render.json carries shounen_bold as 'bold angular eyes, thick eye outlines, shounen style'. The speed lines are the most-used effect tag in this library at 14 uses, but tags/speed_lines.json is emphatic that they DELETE the background they sit in front of - correct at the peak of an impact, destructive on a shot that still has to read as a location. Note also that motion blur belongs in the negative on this checkpoint, never in the positive. | Downgraded to untested: NOTHING in this library was rendered when it was authored, so every strength and engine call is a considered prediction. This project's own standard - written on the Illustrious checkpoint card - is that a recommendation is not a measurement.
verdict: Hard black line and speed fragments; it shattered the background into abstract shards. Style and setting cannot both survive this one.
verified_by: Looked at, against the no-style control at the same seed with the same subject. studio/_tools/style_examples.py
